From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: procurement@cureline.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance litmus & evaluation sprint canvas — Cureline MAP draft

Alex — attaching a first-pass MAP and a short litmus doc for the evaluation sprint. High-level asks below; please confirm the success criteria so we can lock the pilot schedule.

Summary (short):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for live clinical-summary generation at 99% availability during test windows, median token latency <= 250ms, and mean accuracy/QA pass rate >= 92% on your gold set.
- Duration: 3-week evaluation (2-week active + 1-week stabilization & evidence capture).
- Exit gates: data ingress validated, latency & cost profile observed under 1k sessions/day, QA pass rate threshold met, SOC2 evidence & XDR checklist acknowledged.

Acceptance litmus (proposed):
1) Functional correctness: 92%+ agreement with Cureline gold-label set (50 randomized cases + 200 synthetic edge cases).
2) Latency SLO: median per-token generation latency <= 250ms for the 95th percentile of requests during the peak window.
3) Cost guardrail: unit cost per 1k tokens under $3 during evaluation (with caching enabled).
4) Reliability: availability >= 99% across test windows; documented fallbacks work (regional fallback + smaller-model degrade path).
5) Security/compliance: signed evidence of SOC2 controls, log retention & redaction approach accepted, network allowlist test completed.

Operational acceptance tests attached as short-run cards in acceptance-litmus.md. Proposed timeline: kickoff 2027-05-04, smoke tests 2027-05-06 to 05-07, active load 05-10 to 05-21, final evidence week 05-24 to 05-28.

Next steps: please reply with any edits to the litmus tests by EOD Monday (05/03) and confirm procurement contact for contract kickoff.

Attachments: cureline-map-draft.xlsx (MAP timeline + owners), acceptance-litmus.md (test cards + runbook)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Alex / procurement — attaching v2 of the MAP and two short runbooks. Changes made per thread and internal review:

- Gold set: expanded to 150 stratified cases (discharge/consult/progress), plus 250 synthetic-edge cases for adversarial testing.
- Latency SLOs clarified: end-to-end median request latency <= 350ms; server-side median token latency <= 250ms. We'll instrument browser-side timing during smoke.
- Cost & fallback: trial guardrail set to $3.50 / 1k tokens. If exceeded during an initial 48-hour observation window in week 1, Redwood will flip the quantized variant and enable the optimized model path; we will notify Cureline and re-run the same test window to validate.
- Evidence & security: Lauren will coordinate SOC2 report exchange; attached pointer to our SOC2 download link and short XDR checklist.
- Owners & decision points: MAP now includes a short decision ladder for go/no-go on 05/28.

Attachments in this email: cureline-map-v2.xlsx (MAP + owners + timeline), safety-and-fallback.md (fallback decision tree), SOC2-pointer.txt (secure link and audit contact).

Proposed new timeline: kickoff 05/06 (moved one business day to accommodate Cureline), smoke 05/07, active 05/10—05/21, evidence week 05/24—05/28, executive signoff 05/28.

Can you confirm 1) procurement contact for DocuSign and 2) SOC2 access window? If both look good we'll lock the kickoff and Ben will own the smoke test checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.
